latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 0160R

18 August 2026
Time Out Group plc
("Time Out,"
the
"Company"
or the
"Group")
TRADING UPDATE FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 JUNE 2026 (UNAUDITED) AND RELATED PARTY TRANSACTION
FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS
Group
revenue for the year ended 30 June 2026 is expected to be approximately £72m (FY25: £73m), with revenue from continuing operations(1) up 11% to £61m (FY25: £55m).
·
Continuing Market revenue(1) of £40m represents an increase of 8% (FY25: £37m). Markets continue to trade in line with management expectations. The portfolio comprised 13 operational Markets at the year end, with five further Markets in development. The most recent opening, Vancouver, has traded encouragingly since opening in May 2026. Following the year-end, the Group secured its sixth development location on Regent Street at Piccadilly Circus in London.
·
Continuing Media revenue(1) of £21m, an increase of 17% (FY25: £18m).
·
Media returned to adjusted EBITDA profitability, supported by UK and US sales growth, improved client retention, new business wins and the successful delivery of a cost efficiency programme.
·
The process to refinance our maturing senior debt remains ongoing and is progressing in line with expectations.
Continuing Revenue" relates to those trading operations continuing to trade into FY27 as part of the Group. During FY26, Boston Market, Spain Media and APAC Media were all either licensed or franchised to local operators so are excluded from continuing operations. Following these transactions trading revenues and opex from these locations are replaced by a royalty fee. Chicago Market closed in January 2026 and is also excluded from continuing operations.
OPERATIONAL HIGHLIGHTS
Markets
·
Opened three new Markets during FY26-Budapest, New York Union Square and Vancouver-increasing the operational portfolio by 30%, from 10 to 13 locations.
·
The three openings added approximately 88,000 sq ft, 38 kitchens, seven bars and around 1,780 seats to the portfolio; Union Square also introduced the Group's first smaller neighbourhood-format Market.
·
The 13 operational Markets welcomed 12 million visitors across its portfolio.
·
At 30 June 2026, five additional Markets were in development-Abu Dhabi, New Delhi, São Paulo, Prague and Riyadh. New Delhi and São Paulo are the first agreements under the Group's new capital-light Market franchise model, creating the potential for further locations in India and South America.
·
Following the year end, the Group secured a flagship London Market at Piccadilly Circus, bringing the concept to the city where Time Out was founded and increasing the development pipeline to six locations.
Media
·
Global monthly reach increased by 31% to approximately 280 million people across editorial, social, video, newsletters, audio, events and commercial partnerships, supporting the Group's direct proposition to advertisers and brand partners.
·
Time Out's expert city coverage now spans more than 350 cities in over 50 countries. Active registered users increased by 7% to 2.5 million at June 2026, with new registrations generated approximately equally by Media and Markets.
·
The volume of 'best of the city' editorial reviews published each week doubled and the proportion of video content increased, strengthening Time Out's utility and relevance across the channels where audiences increasingly discover city experiences.
·
The revenue mix continued to shift towards higher-value direct client relationships, live experiences, commerce and partnerships. Approximately 53% of UK and US direct Media sales came from repeat clients, while indirect programmatic advertising represented less than 10% of Media revenue.
·
Media generated more than 110,000 attributable transactions and approximately £7.3m of attributable gross merchandise value across accommodation, theatre, attractions, restaurants and Time Out Offers during FY26.
·
Live-events and activation revenue reached approximately £2.4m, supported by campaigns for global brands including Disney Theatrical, Toyota, SailGP, HelloFresh, British Airways and Westfield, with several campaigns combining digital Media with in-Market events and activations.
·
The Group expanded its capital-light Media model through franchise arrangements in Spain, Australia and selected Asian and Eastern Mediterranean territories, and launched dedicated Time Out platforms for Delhi and Mumbai.
·
Time Out's Best Cities research, based on insights from more than 24,000 city residents across 150 cities and input from over 100 local experts, was named Data Initiative of the Year at the 2026 PPA Awards. The initiative generated significant international media coverage and audience engagement, supporting Time Out's editorial authority and proprietary city data proposition.
Loan Note Instrument and Related Party Transaction
Today, Time Out entered into an agreement to increase the value of an existing loan note instrument with its existing shareholder Oakley Capital Limited ("OCL"), first entered into on 26 August 2025 and amended 7 January 2026 ("LN"), from £1.1m to £2.1m. The additional loan of £1.0m will be used to provide growth capital in connection with the new London Market announced previously on 6 August 2026. Interest margin of SONIA + 8% is unchanged. This constitutes an AIM Rule 13 related-party transaction. Further information is included below.
Commenting on the Trading update, Chris Ohlund, CEO of Time Out Group plc, said:
"FY26 was a year of significant operational and strategic progress. We opened three new Markets, expanding the portfolio to 13 locations worldwide, and signed new capital-light Market franchise agreements for India and Brazil.
"At the same time, we accelerated the transformation of Media and returned the division to adjusted EBITDA profitability. Monthly reach grew by 31% to approximately 280 million people, active registered users increased to 2.5 million and we continued to broaden revenues across direct advertising, live experiences, commerce, sponsorship and our physical Markets.
"Time Out's combination of trusted city content, global digital reach and high-quality physical experiences is unique. Together, these capabilities provide a strong platform for further audience, commercial and capital-light growth.
"Following the year end, securing our London flagship at Piccadilly Circus marked one of the most important milestones in Time Out's history. It brings Time Out Market home to the city where the brand was founded and will provide a global showcase for the next generation of our integrated Media and Markets proposition."
RELATED PARTY TRANSACTION
OCL, as the parent company, is an associate of Oakley Capital Investments Limited ("OCI") which is interested in 174,157,477 Ordinary Shares, representing approximately 33.32 per cent. of the Company's issued share capital. OCI is therefore a substantial shareholder in Time Out. As a result, OCL is a related party of the Company. As such, the execution of the LN by the Company constitutes, for the purposes of AIM Rule 13, related party transactions. The Directors of the Company (excluding Peter Dubens, Non-Executive Chairman of the Company, David Till, Non-Executive Director of the Company, Alexander Collins, Non-Executive Director of the Company, who are not considered independent for the purposes of this transaction) consider that, having consulted with the Company's nominated adviser, Panmure Liberum Limited, the terms of the LN are fair and reasonable insofar as shareholders in the Company are concerned.

latest.content:

Time Out Group secures landmark London Market location in Piccadilly Circus
Time Out Group plc (AIM: TMO), the global media and hospitality business, today announces that it has secured a landmark location at The Crown Estate's 10 Piccadilly development (55 Regent Street) to open Time Out Market London, its first Market in its home city.
Expected to open in summer 2028, the Market will overlook the iconic Piccadilly Circus in the heart of London's West End. Located on Regent Street, which attracts an annual footfall of approximately 74 million, it will provide an exceptional setting for the global flagship of the Time Out Market portfolio.
The Market will occupy more than 26,000 sq ft across three floors and will bring together approximately 15 restaurants, bars and food businesses, showcasing a carefully selected mix of established local favourites and emerging talent, alongside a year-round programme of live entertainment and cultural experiences, all curated by Time Out's local editors and experts.
Founded in London in 1968, Time Out has helped millions of people discover the very best of cities worldwide. Inspired by that editorial heritage, Time Out Market has become a globally recognised food and cultural market brand. Since opening the first Time Out Market in Lisbon in 2014, the concept has expanded across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia, with 13 operational Markets together welcoming more than 12 million visitors annually. Time Out Market London will further expand the portfolio, with five additional Markets currently in development.
Time Out's Media business reaches approximately 280 million people every month across editorial, social media, video, newsletters, audio, events and commercial partnerships. Bringing Time Out Market to London creates a unique opportunity to convert that engaged audience into visitors and customers while further strengthening the Time Out brand in its home country.
The project represents an important milestone for Time Out, expanding its owned-and-operated Market portfolio while further integrating the Group's Media and Market businesses.
Chris Ohlund, CEO of Time Out Group plc, said:
"Securing this partnership with The Crown Estate to create our global flagship in the heart of Piccadilly Circus is one of the most significant milestones in Time Out's nearly 60-year history. Bringing the globally recognised Time Out Market concept home to London is both a celebration of where we began and a statement of where we are going."
"London is one of the world's greatest cities for food and culture, and there is no better location than Piccadilly Circus to showcase everything that makes it extraordinary. Together with The Crown Estate, we are creating a destination that will celebrate London's best chefs, restaurateurs, artists and creators while welcoming millions of Londoners and visitors every year."
"As our global flagship, Time Out Market London will also become the blueprint for the next generation of Time Out Markets, bringing together hospitality, culture, media, sponsorship and live experiences in a way that only Time Out can deliver."
Charles Owen, Head of Regent Street at The Crown Estate, said:
"We're proud to welcome the UK's first Time Out Market to Regent Street as the brand's global flagship. It is a significant addition to one of the world's most recognised retail and lifestyle destinations. It reflects the area's continued appeal to innovative international brands and demonstrates our long-term commitment to investing in Regent Street, curating a diverse mix of experiences that attract visitors, workers and residents alike."
"Set within this carefully restored historic building, Time Out Market will introduce an exciting new food and drink destination in the heart of London's West End. As significant investment and development continue to take shape across the area, it will further strengthen Regent Street's hospitality offer, helping to drive footfall, broaden the destination's appeal and meet growing demand from the millions of people who visit, live and work here each year."
The exact opening date and culinary partners will be announced in due course.

Time Out Group plc
("Time Out", the "Company" or the "Group")
Time Out Group signs 10-year franchise agreement with ITP Media Group for Hong Kong and Singapore
Time Out Group plc (AIM: TMO), the global media and hospitality business, today announces that it has entered into a new 10-year franchise agreement with ITP Media Group ("ITP") covering Time Out's Media operations in Hong Kong and Singapore.
Under the agreement, ITP will operate Time Out Hong Kong and Time Out Singapore, including their editorial operations, digital platforms, social channels, events and experiential activations. The agreement builds on a successful partnership spanning more than 20 years, during which ITP has operated Time Out franchises across the Gulf Cooperation Council ("GCC"), including Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Bahrain, Doha, Riyadh and Jeddah. ITP Media Group is a leading media company operating more than 40 brands and over 200 live events annually, reaching a global monthly audience of more than 200 million across digital, social, print and live platforms.
Hong Kong and Singapore are well-established Time Out Media businesses with strong audiences and significant long-term growth potential. The new agreement supports Time Out's strategy of partnering with experienced local operators to grow the Media business while maintaining the editorial quality, trusted recommendations and city expertise that define the Time Out brand.
Rob Biagioni, CEO of Time Out Media, said:
"ITP has been a trusted Time Out franchise partner for more than 20 years, and this new 10-year agreement reflects the strength of that relationship and our confidence in their ability to continue growing the brand.
Hong Kong and Singapore are two of Asia's most exciting urban destinations and remain important markets for Time Out. We are delighted to be working with ITP on this next chapter and look forward to seeing the brand continue to thrive in both cities."
Martin Chambers, Managing Director of ITP Media Group, said:
"We are proud to strengthen our long-standing relationship with Time Out through this new agreement.
Time Out is one of the world's most recognisable city brands, and Hong Kong and Singapore are territories with enormous opportunities for growth across content, commercial partnerships, events and experiences. We look forward to building on Time Out's strong foundations and continuing to connect audiences with the very best of city life."
The transaction supports the Group's strategy of partnering with established local operators in selected territories while generating recurring franchise fee income from the Time Out brand. As part of the transaction, the Time Out Hong Kong and Singapore Media teams will transfer to ITP Media Group and continue supporting the business under the new franchise structure.
Completion of the transaction is occurring immediately. Time Out Hong Kong and Time Out Singapore will continue operating without interruption for readers, commercial partners and contributors.

latest.content:

Time Out Group plc
("Time Out", the "Company" or the "Group")
Time Out Group signs franchise agreement to bring Time Out Market to South America
Time Out Group plc (AIM: TMO), the global media and hospitality business, today announces that it has signed a master franchise agreement with Giunina LLC, a company established by Brazilian hospitality and entertainment executive Benjamin Ramalho to develop and operate Time Out Market Brazil.
The agreement will bring Time Out Market to South America, with a location in São Paulo expected to open in the first quarter of 2027. The project is expected to become a significant addition to São Paulo's food and cultural landscape, serving both residents and visitors in South America's largest metropolis.
Time Out Market currently operates in 13 cities worldwide and has a further five locations in development. The São Paulo Market will combine Time Out Market's globally recognised editorially curated model with a locally tailored offering reflecting the city's food, drink and cultural scene.
Chris Ohlund, CEO of Time Out Group, said:
"São Paulo is one of the world's great food cities and an exciting next step in Time Out Market's global expansion. We are delighted to partner with Benjamin Ramalho and the team at Giunina LLC to bring our market concept to the region and look forward to creating a destination that showcases the very best of the city's culinary and cultural talent."
Benjamin Ramalho, CEO of Giunina LLC and Founder of Time Out Market Brazil, said:
"We are thrilled to bring Time Out Market to one of South America's most vibrant cities. With its cultural diversity, dynamic food scene and a public eager to discover new experiences, São Paulo is a natural fit for the first Time Out Market in the region."
This is the second Time Out Market franchise agreement signed by the Group, following the launch of its franchise model in India in 2025, and represents a further step in the expansion of the Time Out Market business into new high-growth markets.
Under the franchise agreement, Giunina LLC, through Time Out Market Brazil, will be responsible for the development and operation of the Market in the country, including site selection, leasing, culinary curation and day-to-day operations, with strategic guidance and support from Time Out Group. The Group will generate revenue through contractual franchise fees and ongoing payments, while not contributing capital towards the development of the Market.
The exact location, opening date and culinary partners will be announced in due course.

Time Out Group plc
("Time Out", the "Company" or the "Group")
Time Out Australia Franchise Agreement
Time Out Group plc (AIM: TMO), the global media and hospitality business, is pleased to announce that it has entered into a long-term franchise agreement with Vinyl Group Ltd (ASX: VNL) ("Vinyl Group", or "Vinyl"), a leading Australian media business, as part of the transition of Time Out Australia's media operations to Vinyl.
Under the agreement, Vinyl Group will acquire the entire issued share capital of Print & Digital Publishing Pty Ltd, the operator of Time Out Australia, and will become the exclusive franchise partner for the Time Out brand in Australia.
The franchise agreement has an initial term of five years and provides for automatic annual renewals thereafter, subject to customary termination provisions.
Under the terms of the franchise agreement, Time Out will receive ongoing royalty payments together with annual minimum guaranteed payments. Time Out will continue to provide brand support, editorial standards and strategic guidance to ensure the Time Out brand continues to serve audiences across Australia.
The transaction supports the Group's strategy of partnering with established local operators in selected territories while generating recurring, capital-light revenue streams from the Time Out brand.
Completion of the transaction is expected to occur on 24 June 2026, subject only to the expiry of a customary cooling-off period.
Rob Biagioni, CEO of Time Out Media, said:
"Australia is an important territory for Time Out, and we're proud of the business and audience we have built over many years. Vinyl has a strong track record of growing premium media brands and connecting audiences with real-world experiences, making them the ideal partner for Time Out in Australia. We are excited to work together to continue growing the Time Out brand and helping Australians discover the very best of their cities."
Vinyl Group CEO & Executive Director, Josh Simons, added
: "This is a highly strategic acquisition that brings one of the world's most iconic culture brands into the Vinyl Media portfolio. Time Out strengthens our position at the intersection of content and real-world experiences, and expands our reach into high-value audiences across Australia. It is another important step in building a scaled, premium publishing platform."

company_30s.what_they_do: Time Out Group runs a global network of city guides, magazines and branded restaurants.  Their core business is publishing local city‑guide titles and operating food‑service venues under the Time Out brand.
company_30s.why_they_matter: The city‑guide market is still huge – millions of tourists and locals rely on Time Out for recommendations.  The company’s franchise model lets it scale its restaurant concept worldwide without the heavy capital outlay that a traditional restaurant chain would need, giving it a competitive edge in high‑traffic urban areas.
company_30s.current_state: After a period of declining print sales, Time Out has shifted focus to its franchise restaurant and market concepts, signing deals in Hong Kong, Singapore, South America and the U.S.  The group is still in a rebuilding phase, with cash burn and modest revenue growth, but it is trading at a deep discount to its pre‑pandemic valuation.

rns_narrative: The latest announcements paint a picture of a company that is actively pivoting from a legacy magazine model to a global franchise network.  Over the past year the group has secured several new restaurant and market licences in Asia and the Americas, while also raising capital to fund the rollout.

Two key themes emerge: 1) **Franchise expansion** – new deals in Hong Kong, Singapore, South America and the U.S. 2) **Capital raising** – a £8 million placing and a recent loan facility that give the company breathing room to grow.
These moves suggest the company is stabilising its cash flow and positioning itself for a turnaround, rather than simply fighting a declining print business.

If the company announces a further capital raise or a strategic partnership that reduces debt, that could calm risk‑averse investors.
